'''Yosotarashi-hime''' (世襲足媛) was [[empress consort of Japan]] from 447 to 392 BC, and then empress dowager from 392 respectively.<ref name=":0">Aston. W.G. (1896) “Nihongi Volume 1: Chronicles of Japan from the Earliest Times to AD697”. Tuttle Publishing.</ref>

== Life ==
She was the wife of [[Emperor Kōshō]].<ref name=":0" /> From this union bore many children, including [[Emperor Kōan]]. Her father changes between the [[Kojiki]], and [[Nihon Shoki]], with her brother in the Kojiki, Okitsuyoso, being listed as her father in the Nihon-Shoki.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite book |last=Ō no |first=Yasumaro |author-link=Ō no Yasumaro |url=https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/23966636-the-kojiki |title=The Kojiki: An Account of Ancient Matters |publisher=[[Columbia University Press]] |translator-last=Heldt |translator-first=Gustav}}</ref> Little information exists about her. Her husband belongs to a group of Emperor's known as "[[Nihon Shoki#Kesshi Hachidai|Kesshi-hachidai]]" or "eight generations lacking history".<ref name=":0" /> As such there is little information about her and her husband.
